summary: aac-tools/checks/handover_equality.py plus the KubeCoder annotation fixture beside it prove R8 on the real case: a throwaway clone of /work/KubeCoderDeploy rendered at --stage prd by the generator from source reproduces the published helm-charts prd subset id for id — 9 elements, 16 relations, only producer/logo/stats.image differing and the 4 cross-stage relations excluded by derivation. The target is derived from the live dataset each run, the comparison is set equality both ways, and the check was proven to fail on a dropped annotation line, a mutated element field and a planted element. Nothing landed in KubeCoderDeploy; kc project lint | test | build are green from the ArgoCDTools root.
